ideas.idea: Load catalogue data at build/server time (route loader) so product list is in HTML
ideas.why: Catalogue.jsx fetches /api/mugs in useEffect, so even prerendered HTML would be empty.

ideas.idea: Give each route a unique title
ideas.why: All routes share the 'Vite App' title and per-route titles are concrete and feasible with React 19.

ideas.idea: Add per-route meta description and canonical link
ideas.why: index.html has none, and canonical/description per route help search snippets and duplicate handling.
index.html lacks a viewport meta, which affects mobile rendering and mobile-first indexing.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD structured data (Organization, Product, ItemList)
ideas.why: Site has no structured data and it is a mugs shop in Bristol, so Organization/Product markup fits.

ideas.idea: Create product detail pages with own URLs, headings, price/description/image, linked from the list
ideas.why:
Catalogue renders bare

names with no links, giving crawlers nothing to index per product.

ideas.idea: Add width/height, fetchpriority and modern formats to hero image
ideas.why: Accurate performance advice for the hero img but small effect and applicable to any site.

ideas.idea: hero.jpg is missing from public/ so image 404s
ideas.why: The provided file list only shows some files and cannot establish that hero.jpg is absent; the claim is unverifiable and likely based on an incomplete listing.

ideas.idea: Expand Home content with materials, care, shipping, returns, and FAQs
ideas.why: Thin content is true, but the mandatory FAQ framing is folklore-ish and the advice is not tied to repo specifics.

ideas.idea: Add About/contact page with real address and email for E-E-A-T
ideas.why: Reasonable trust advice that would apply to nearly any business site.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card tags
ideas.why: index.html has none, and link previews for a shop are a concrete benefit.

ideas.idea: Add error handling/fallback message to the catalogue fetch
ideas.why: Valid robustness fix but minimal effect on discoverability.
Applies to almost any site with very little SEO effect.

ideas.idea: Add a catch-all 404 route and return real HTTP 404 status
ideas.why: main.jsx has no * route so unknown URLs render only the nav, creating soft 404s.
llms.txt is folklore as a way to be found, though the report itself hedges it.
